input: Get a carbon monoxide detector for every floor

gold.taskTitle: Buy carbon monoxide detectors for every floor
gold.taskDescription: Purchase and install a carbon monoxide detector on each floor of the user's home.

questions.title: How many floors does your home have?
questions.description: Determines the exact number of detectors needed.

questions.title: Do you already own any CO detectors?
questions.description: Identifies whether partial coverage already exists and how many new units are needed.

questions.title: What is your budget per detector?
questions.description: Helps narrow down suitable product options within a price range.

questions.title: Do you prefer battery-powered or plug-in detectors?
questions.description: Determines the power source preference to guide product selection.

questions.title: Should the detectors also detect smoke?
questions.description: Clarifies whether a combination CO-and-smoke detector is preferred over CO-only.

questions.title: Where do you plan to buy them, online or in-store?
questions.description: Shapes the purchasing approach, delivery timeline, and retailer options.

questions.title: Is there a deadline by which these must be installed?
questions.description: Establishes urgency and helps prioritize the steps in the plan.
